scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter admin exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter gallery exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter admin lint && pnpm --filter gallery lint && pnpm --filter api lint
scripts.check: pnpm docs:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.build: pnpm build:admin && pnpm build:gallery && pnpm build:api
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.tenant:bootstrap: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter api tenant:bootstrap
scripts.uploads:cleanup: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter api uploads:cleanup
scripts.usage:reconcile: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter api usage:reconcile
scripts.billing:expire: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter api billing:expire
scripts.billing:reconcile: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter api billing:reconcile
scripts.telegram:webhook: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter api telegram:webhook
scripts.ops: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter api ops
